jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
**Officer – Full Stack Engineer**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in enterprise application development, low\-latency services, and cloud\-native product engineering. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on coding ability across backend and frontend technologies with the ability to independently deliver high\-quality modules from design through production release.


As an Officer, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of full\-stack components and services, working closely with product owners, architects, QA, and engineering peers to translate business requirements into scalable, resilient, and secure solutions. This role is suited for an engineer who can operate independently, make sound technical decisions at the component level, and mentor junior team members while contributing to pod\-level engineering excellence.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently design, build, test, and deploy full\-stack modules and application features end\-to\-end.
* Own component\-level technical design, including backend services, frontend interactions, API contracts, data models, and integration points.
* Develop and maintain backend services in Python and/or Java and frontend applications using React and/or Angular.
* Build and enhance RESTful APIs, service integrations, and business logic layers supporting platform and product capabilities.
* Deliver responsive, reusable, and maintainable frontend components aligned with UX, accessibility, and design standards.
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices within the pod, including testing, code quality, CI/CD, documentation, secure coding, and release readiness.
* Deploy and support applications on cloud\-native platforms, including AWS and/or Azure.
* Troubleshoot production issues across application, API, integration, and infrastructure layers; contribute to root\-cause analysis and post\-incident reviews.
* Collaborate with architects and product teams to refine requirements, estimate technical effort, and propose implementation options.
* Mentor Senior Associates through code reviews, technical guidance, and day\-to\-day support on design and delivery.
* Contribute to improvements in performance, observability, maintainability, scalability, and developer experience across the pod.
* Support application monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational practices to maintain service reliability.
* Participate actively in sprint ceremonies, design sessions, and engineering reviews, helping raise technical quality across the team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–10 years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands\-on experience in full\-stack development.
* Strong proficiency in Java and/or Python for backend engineering.
* Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
* Solid understanding of API design, microservices, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience designing and supporting production\-grade applications with ownership of performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, cloud\-native deployment models, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Docker, and working knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance\-aware query design.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills across frontend, backend, and deployment layers.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Exposure to event\-driven architecture, Kafka, or asynchronous messaging patterns.
* Experience with GraphQL, API gateways, and integration middleware.
* Familiarity with observability tools, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting platforms.
* Exposure to low\-latency systems or high\-throughput enterprise platforms.
* Experience in financial services, capital markets, or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to GenAI/LLM\-enabled product features is a plus.
* Cloud certifications in AWS and/or Azure are a plus.

**Work Schedule**

On\-premise


**Keywords**

Full Stack Engineering, Java, Python, React, Angular, Cloud\-Native, AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Microservices, REST APIs, Frontend Development, Backend Development, Distributed Systems, Enterprise Applications, Docker, Kubernetes, Production Support, Scalable Systems, Agile Delivery, API Integration


**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Cloud \& Infrastructure** to work closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Business stakeholders across **APAC and AMER** regions.

The role will span both **Platform and Applications layers** of the infrastructure stack. The successful candidate will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, product leadership, and technical engineering teams, helping translate business requirements into well\-defined Epics, user stories, and actionable sprint deliverables.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **Agile/Scrum environments**, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a good understanding of **cloud, infrastructure, platform engineering, and DevOps concepts**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Requirements \& Intake Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming business and technical intake requests across APAC and AMER.
* Engage with requestors and stakeholders to understand and clarify:
* Business requirements
* Scope and priorities
* Expected outcomes
* Dependencies
* Acceptance criteria
* Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert business initiatives into well\-defined **Epics**.
* Break down Epics into clear, actionable, and sprint\-ready **User Stories**.
* Define measurable and unambiguous acceptance criteria for user stories.
* Ensure requirements are properly documented, prioritized, and communicated to relevant stakeholders.

2\. Agile Delivery \& Sprint Support

* Support Agile delivery activities including **backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, retrospectives, and sprint reviews**.
* Work with Product Managers and Engineering teams to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Ensure user stories are adequately refined and ready for sprint execution.
* Track sprint progress and proactively identify:
* Risks
* Blockers
* Dependencies
* Delays
* Capacity constraints
* Coordinate with Engineering Managers to monitor team capacity and delivery commitments.
* Track and report Agile metrics such as:
* Sprint velocity
* Burndown
* Backlog health
* Delivery progress
* Dependencies and risks
* Run or co\-facilitate **Daily Stand\-Ups (DSUs)** across different time zones when required.

3\. Stakeholder \& Program Support

* Act as a bridge between **Business, Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams**.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders across APAC and AMER.
* Follow up with **Public Cloud and Enterprise Hybrid Cloud (EHC)** teams on outstanding actions, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare concise, business\-friendly status updates, dashboards, and reports for leadership.
* Communicate complex technical information in a clear and business\-oriented manner.
* Assist Product Managers in maintaining and communicating **product roadmaps**.
* Support cross\-functional initiatives and ensure action items are tracked through completion.
* Proactively escalate critical risks and dependencies to the appropriate stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

* **4\+ years of professional experience** as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Scrum Master, Delivery Support Specialist, or similar role.
* Experience working within **infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, applications, or technology environments**.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Experience with:
* Sprint Planning
* Backlog Refinement
* User Story Creation
* Acceptance Criteria
* Daily Stand\-Ups
* Sprint Reviews
* Retrospectives
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise Agile/project management tools such as **Jira, Rally, Azure DevOps**, or equivalent.
* General technical understanding of infrastructure concepts, including:
* Networking
* Storage
* Databases
* Operating Systems
* Compute/Virtualization
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple intake requests, priorities, dependencies, and action items simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills.

Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications

* Hands\-on exposure to public cloud platforms such as:
* **AWS – EC2, VPC, S3, RDS**
* Microsoft Azure
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Understanding of **hybrid cloud and on\-premises infrastructure environments**.
* Experience working directly with **Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps teams**.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology transformation or cloud migration initiatives.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and modern application platforms.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams across multiple time zones.
* Certifications such as:
* **CSM / PSM – Certified Scrum Master**
* **CSPO – Certified Scrum Product Owner**
* **AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner**

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

jobs.title: senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As a **Senior Product Designer**, you will play a pivotal role in defining the product strategy and crafting exceptional user experiences for our Partner Platform. You will work with a high degree of ownership, leading initiatives from problem discovery through execution while partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, and key stakeholders.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with exceptional execution, enjoys solving complex business problems, and is passionate about creating scalable, user\-centric experiences. You'll influence product direction, shape design standards, and drive measurable outcomes—not just beautiful interfaces.**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design seamless, intuitive experiences across multiple platforms, balancing simple mobile workflows for field agents with powerful, data\-rich web experiences for administrators.
* Own end\-to\-end design for complex product areas—from discovery, research, and ideation to prototyping, validation, and delivery.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams to define product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization.
* Plan, conduct, and synthesize user research, transforming customer insights into actionable product decisions.
* Create scalable interaction models, information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished UI designs.
* Contribute to and continuously evolve the design system by establishing reusable components, patterns, and design standards.
* Champion usability, accessibility, consistency, and design quality across the product ecosystem.
* Communicate design rationale effectively through storytelling, presentations, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Mentor designers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of design excellence.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years of experience designing complex digital products, with significant experience in enterprise or B2B SaaS platforms.
* A strong portfolio showcasing end\-to\-end product design, strategic thinking, and measurable business impact.
* Experience designing products within healthcare services or other highly regulated, data\-intensive industries is highly preferred.
* Proven ability to simplify complex workflows and build scalable product experiences.
* Deep understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and design systems.
* Expertise in user research methodologies and translating insights into product improvements.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence decisions across cross\-functional teams.
* A systems\-thinking mindset with a passion for solving meaningful customer problems.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Work on complex, high\-impact products that challenge conventional UX thinking.
* Influence product strategy and contribute to experiences used at scale.
* Be part of a collaborative, cross\-functional team where design is a strategic partner in product development.
* Shape the future of a platform that empowers millions of users through intuitive digital and human\-assisted experiences.
* Enjoy the autonomy to solve meaningful problems while growing alongside a team that values innovation, craftsmanship, and continuous learning.

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.


**Your Team's Impact**

  

We are seeking a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of the Catalog and Governance capabilities within the FactSet Intelligence Platform (FIP) Data Layer.  



  

This role owns the catalog as the authoritative system connecting semantic models, and physical data sets, enabling trusted, secure, and discoverable data across domains. The Senior Principal Product Manager will implement governance frameworks, model standards, and catalog services that support scalable domain onboarding, data model compliance, and AI\-ready data access. As a senior leader, this role also drives insights\-based product discovery and cross\-functional strategy alignment.  



  

**What You'll Do**

Insights — Derives insights to support product bets


* Understands the dynamics of domain teams, governance \& standards office, platform consumers, and stakeholders relying on catalog and governance capabilities; builds this understanding through regular and direct engagement.
* Owns product discovery for catalog and governance capabilities — proactively validates opportunities (e.g., model standards, lineage tooling, compliance frameworks) to prove value, viability, feasibility, and usability before development.
* Uses catalog adoption, model quality, and governance compliance data to evaluate and inform strategy and decision\-making.
* Measures what matters: discoverability, trust, and access enablement, alongside adoption, engagement, and compliance metrics.

Strategy — Identifies and articulates a path to achieve results


* Defines and executes the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for Catalog \& Governance in the context of the FIP Data Layer and overall platform strategy.
* Evangelizes catalog and governance strategy across domain and platform teams.
* Owns business case development for governance tooling and catalog investment (resourcing, KPIs).
* Accountable for adoption, compliance, and domain onboarding goals.
* Partners with the Governance office and domain teams to operationalize governance requirements and best practices.
* Creates a product roadmap that aligns Data Platform, Semantics, Security, Architecture, and Domain teams, sharing timelines, constraints, and dependencies.

Execution — Delivers on product outcomes


* Establishes the catalog as the system of record for model, domain definitions, and physical data assets.
* Defines logical\-to\-physical data mappings to enable semantic discovery and governed data access.
* Ensures model quality, completeness, lineage, and lifecycle management standards.
* Delivers governance tooling, policies, and measurement frameworks that enable compliance at scale.
* Implements standards for data classification, privacy, security, access controls, and auditability based on the Governance Framework.
* Enables seamless resolution from business concepts and user intent to governed data assets.
* Partners with development teams to define acceptance criteria and deliver usable, well\-governed products.
* As a subject matter expert in catalog and governance, serves as a resource for complex support escalations and advocates for reducing support burden.

Leadership — Inspires cross\-functional teams to achieve great outcomes


* Influences and motivates Data Platform, Semantics, Security, Architecture, Governance \& Standards office and Domain teams, without authority, to achieve catalog and governance outcomes.
* Drives adoption of governance and catalog best practices across the department.
* Coordinates delivery across multiple domain and cross platform teams.

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills


* 15\+ years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in data platforms, governance, metadata, or analytics ecosystems.
* Experience with data catalogs, data model management, data governance, and enterprise data architecture.
* Strong understanding of logical data modeling, data lineage, and mapping business concepts to physical data assets.
* Proven success delivering platform products across multiple teams and stakeholders at scale, including influencing without direct authority.

**What's In It For You**

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:


* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.
* A global community dedicated to volunteerism and sustainability, where collaboration is always encouraged, and individuality drives solutions.
* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.
* Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

  



Salary is just one component of our compensation package and is based on several factors including but not limited to …

jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Are you excited about empowering millions of developers and AI/ML builders across enterprises and digital natives with the best experience to build, test, and scale their applications with AI? Do you love turning data into insight, and insight into product decisions that shape how developers code every day?


The GitHub Copilot Science team under CoreAI at Microsoft India Development Center (IDC) is looking for a data\-driven product manager to help define, measure, and ship AI\-powered coding experiences for developers. Our division's mission is to empower builders and their teams to achieve more.


We are a fast\-paced, experimentation\-first team. We love to push the boundaries of what is possible with AI\-assisted development. If this sounds like the kind of environment where you will grow and have fun, please join us!

 **Responsibilities**  

In this role you will:

* Partner closely with data science, applied science, and engineering to own the data, models, agentic harness and measurement strategy for Copilot / VS Code experiences and connect them to real online outcomes.
* Define the online and offline metrics that tell us whether a feature is working and moving developer productivity.
* Perform deep quantitative and qualitative analysis of developer telemetry, usage funnels, and model\-quality signals to surface unarticulated and unmet needs.
* Design, run, and interpret A/B flights and controlled experiments end to end, from hypothesis and power analysis through readout and ship/no\-ship decisions.
* Drive prompt engineering and model\-behavior improvements in partnership with applied scientists.
* Engage directly with the developer community \- forums, GitHub, user studies, and early\-adopter programs \- to validate direction with real users.
* Analyze competition and market trends across AI coding assistants to build a coherent strategy for growing adoption and engagement.
* Define success metrics, communicate them clearly, measure them, and use them to iteratively improve the services.

Traits we look for in product managers:

* Relentless customer obsession paired with rigorous attention to data quality and detail.
* Comfort living in the data \- you reach for a query or a notebook before an opinion.
* Active listening to understand (Growth mindset).
* Clarity in communication without ambiguity across all formats. Break down complex ideas and explain them simply with data.
 **Qualifications*** 6\+ years of product management experience shipping enterprise or consumer products in the software industry. Experience building large\-scale AI/ML products/services is preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in data analysis and experimentation \- designing and interpreting A/B flights, defining online and offline metrics, and driving decisions from telemetry.
* Hands\-on comfort with data tools (notebooks, and dashboards such as Kusto/ADX, Power BI, or similar) to independently explore data and validate hypotheses.
* Familiarity with LLM and Copilot technologies, including prompt engineering, model evaluation, and awareness of the AI\-assisted developer tooling landscape.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a similar discipline, or equivalent industry experience. An MBA is a bonus.
* Strong analytical skills and an aptitude for solving complex business problems.

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager – Publicator & Digital Products
jobs.description:
**Vær med til at forme fremtidens digitale platform til nogle af Danmarks største** 
**retailvirksomheder.**
 Hos Brandhouse hjælper vi hver dag nogle af Danmarks stærkeste retailbrands med at håndtere komplekse marketing\- og produktflows. Det gør vi gennem Publicator – vores egen digitale platform, som gennem mere end 20 år er blevet udviklet i tæt samarbejde med vores kunder.
   

  

 Nu står vi overfor næste store udvikling.
   

  

 AI, automatisering og nye digitale arbejdsgange ændrer den måde, vores kunder arbejder på. Det stiller nye krav til Publicator – og åbner samtidig op for nye muligheder. Derfor søger vi en Digital Product Manager, der har lyst til at være med til at definere produktets næste kapitel.
   

  

 Om rollen \& ansvarsområder
   

  

 Som Digital Product Manager får du ansvaret for at sætte den strategiske retning for Publicator og sikre, at produktet fortsat udvikler sig i takt med vores kunders behov og den teknologiske udvikling.
   

  

 Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med nogle af Danmarks største retailvirksomheder for at forstå deres forretning, arbejdsgange og udfordringer. Med afsæt i den indsigt får du ansvaret for at omsætte kundernes behov til en langsigtet produktstrategi, tydelige udviklingsprioriteter og konkrete initiativer, der skaber størst mulig forretningsværdi for både kunderne og Brandhouse.
   

  

 Samtidig bliver du bindeleddet mellem kunder, forretning og udvikling. Du får ansvaret for at skabe retning i den daglige produktudvikling og sikre, at udviklingsteamet har klare prioriteringer og de bedste forudsætninger for at omsætte strategien til løsninger, der skaber værdi.
   

  

**Du Kommer Blandt Andet Til At**
* Udvikle og drive produktvisionen og roadmappet for Publicator.
* Opbygge en dyb forståelse for vores kunders forretning, processer og fremtidige behov.
* Omsætte kundeindsigter til produktstrategi, udviklingsprioriteter og konkrete initiativer.
* Prioritere og planlægge udviklingen ud fra kundeværdi, kommercielt potentiale og teknisk realiserbarhed.
* Arbejde tæt sammen med kunder, udviklere og ledelsen om produktets videre udvikling.


 Din profil
   

  

 Vi leder efter en person, der motiveres af at udvikle digitale produkter og skabe værdi i krydsfeltet mellem kunder, forretning og teknologi. Du trives med at skabe retning og overblik i komplekse sammenhænge og motiveres af at få forskellige fagligheder til at arbejde mod et fælles mål.
   

  

**Vi Forestiller Os, At Du**
* Har erfaring med digital produktudvikling – gerne som Digital Product Manager, Product Manager eller fra en lignende rolle.
* Har arbejdet med komplekse digitale produkter eller SaaS\-løsninger.
* Har erfaring med at samarbejde tæt med udviklingsteams og omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete udviklingsopgaver.
* Er god til at skabe struktur, prioritere og sikre fremdrift i udviklingsarbejdet.
* Trives med en rolle, hvor du er det daglige bindeled mellem kunder, forretning og udviklere.
* Er en dygtig kommunikator, der kan skabe tillid på tværs af både tekniske og kommercielle profiler.
* Er nysgerrig på AI, digital transformation og udviklingen af digitale produkter.


 Succeskriterier
   

  

 Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svar fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, udfordrer eksisterende løsninger og skaber stærke relationer til både kunder og kolleger.
   

  

**Efter Dit Første År Forventer Vi, At**
* Du har opbygget stærke relationer til vores største kunder og har en dyb forståelse for deres forretning.
* Der er etableret en tydelig produktstrategi og et prioriteret roadmap for Publicator.
* Udviklingsprioriteterne understøtter både kundernes behov og Brandhouses forretningsmål.
* Muligheder inden for AI, integrationer og produktforbedringer er identificeret og omsat til konkrete initiativer.
* Publicator står endnu stærkere som en strategisk platform for både vores kunder og Brandhouse.


 Derfor skal du vælge Brandhouse
   

  

 Hos Brandhouse bliver du en del af et tværfagligt miljø med mere end 65 generalister og specialister inden for strategi, branding, design, marketing, PR, teknologi og produktion.
   

  

 Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger bliver skabt, når forskellige fagligheder arbejder tæt sammen, og når beslutningsvejene er korte.
   

  

 Hos os får du ikke bare ansvar for et produkt. Du får mulighed for at præge udviklingen af en platform, som allerede spiller en vigtig rolle hos nogle af Danmarks største retailvirksomheder – og som har et stort potentiale for den næste fase af sin udvikling.
   

  

* En strategisk rolle med stor frihed, ansvar og reel indflydelse.
* Tæt samarbejde med ledelsen, kunder og et erfarent udviklingsteam.
* Et stærkt fagligt miljø med mere end 65 specialister på tværs af strategi, design, teknologi, marketing og produktion.
* Moderne kontorfaciliteter på Østerbro med egen kantine og få minutters gang fra Nordhavn Station.
* Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.


 Om Brandhouse
   

  

 Brandhouse er et af Danmarks førende bureauer inden for strategi, branding, design, marketing, PR og digitale løsninger. Med mere end 65 generalister og specialister hjælper vi nogle af landets stærkeste brands med at skabe vækst gennem stærkere kundeoplevelser, mere effektive processer og løsninger, der skaber reel forretningsværdi.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Data Publishing and Processing
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
 You're passionate about making data easy to publish, trustworthy to consume, and fast to power AI\-driven decisions. Join our Data Publishing \& Processing (DPP) organization to lead products that simplify and standardize the end‑to‑end publishing experience across ingestion, transformation, quality, orchestration, and governed delivery. You will help deliver a unified, intelligent platform that reduces time‑to‑publish, lowers cost‑to‑serve, and enforces quality checks and lineage.
   

  

 As a Product Manager in Data Publishing and Processing team , you will define and execute the strategy for a modern data publishing and processing framework that serves thousands of applications and diverse personas (data engineers, data owners, analysts, and AI agents). You will lead the product lifecycle from discovery to launch and continuous improvement, balancing performance, cost, security, and compliance. Partnering closely with engineering, architecture, governance, and lines of business, you will deliver reusable blueprints, zero‑touch onboarding, and observability that make publishing fast, safe, and self‑service across our managed lake and consumption platforms.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the product strategy and vision for a unified data publishing and processing platform that integrates with enterprise catalogs, entitlements, and observability.
* Lead discovery and customer research to translate publisher needs into a prioritized roadmap (e.g., onboarding, ingestion, processing frameworks, and platform adapters).
* Define and deliver reusable solutions for common publishing use cases (e.g., sor‑to‑lake, streaming, transform to refined, externalization to consumption platforms).
* Define and deliver AI powered solutions to help customers convert from legacy to modern data processing solutions
* Drive platform capabilities for Onboarding \& self‑service which could range from Orchestration ,Processing (PySpark/SQL/streaming frameworks; serverless where appropriate); Test Data Service; Data quality \& readiness (DQ/PII checks, contract validation, versioning) ;Catalog \& entitlement integration (registration, lineage, access; Observability \& SLOs (time‑to‑publish, error rates, cost guardrails) policies)
* Own and maintain the product backlog; write clear requirements and acceptance criteria; ensure value delivery via iterative releases and measurement.
* Establish and track success metrics (e.g., time‑to‑publish, publish error rate, adoption/NPS, cost per dataset) and course‑correct based on data.
* Partner with platform engineering, governance, SRE/L2, and vendor teams to ensure reliability (multi‑region failover where needed), security, compliance, and cost efficiency at scale.
* Champion a contracts‑first, API‑first approach that prepares the platform for autonomous and AI‑assisted publishing workflows.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 8\+ years of product management or adjacent experience in data platforms/analytics/cloud in highly matrixed environments, with a track record of shipping platform capabilities at scale.
* Advanced knowledge of the product development lifecycle, discovery methods, and data‑informed prioritization; demonstrated ability to lead end‑to‑end (strategy → ideation → requirements → launch → iteration).
* Hands‑on experience with ETL/ELT tooling and patterns (e.g., Informatica, Ab Initio, dbt, Spark/PySpark/Glue, SQL, Databricks) for batch and streaming
* Working knowledge of modern data lake/lakehouse stacks and table formats (e.g., Iceberg/Delta/Hudi), and how they enable consumption via platforms such as Snowflake.
* Familiarity with orchestration platforms (e.g., Airflow/MWAA), CI/CD, and observability practices for data pipelines (quality, lineage, SLAs/SLOs).
* Experience on serverless and cloud‑native data processing with any one of AWS/Azure/GCP (e.g., Glue, EMR, Databricks, EKS, Lambda), and cost/performance optimization in cloud.
* Experience integrating with data catalogs/metadata systems and entitlement services; comfort with contracts‑as‑code, schema/versioning, and readiness checks.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to translate customer needs into platform capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Analytical skills to instrument, monitor, and improve platform health and business KPIs (time‑to‑publish, error rates, cost efficiency, adoption/NPS).


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Business.
* Experience building large‑scale enterprise data platforms in financial services or similarly regulated environments, including familiarity with privacy, security, and audit requirements.
* Knowledge of data contracts, semantic/technical lineage, and policy enforcement (entitlements, tag/column/row‑level access).
* Experience with migrations and large program implementations

 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Unified Experience Agentic Platform
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
   

  

 We are looking for a Product Manager, Agentic AI Platforms to set the product vision and own the roadmap for our enterprise AI \& Engineering capability — a portfolio of AI agents and the shared engineering platform (orchestration, integration, AI operations, and quality) that powers them. This is a senior, vision\-setting product role: you will decide what we build and why, take new agent concepts from concept to production, and grow the capability from point solutions into a governed, reusable platform that scales across the business.
   

  

**Understanding of AI and agentic systems is the anchor of this role — it is the primary skill we are hiring for.** 
 Around that anchor, you bring genuine engineering breadth (modern web development, cloud, and ML), the craft of product management, and the stakeholder leadership to align business, engineering, architecture, and governance. Above all, you bring a
 **proven product vision and a track record of building AI and engineering products from scratch** 
 — not just running an existing backlog.
   

  

 You will report to the Leader — AI \& Engineering and operate as a peer to architecture, engineering, AI operations, and delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Set and evangelize the product vision and multi\-quarter roadmap for the capability — the agent portfolio plus the platform that powers it.
* Decide what to build and why: shape the agent portfolio, sequence delivery, and make build / buy / defer calls grounded in business value, feasibility, and risk.
* Drive 0→1 product development — take new agent concepts from idea to prototype, MVP, and production, defining the minimum lovable product and iterating with real users.
* Partner as a technical peer with architecture and engineering across web, cloud, and ML/LLM stacks — engaging on system design and trade\-offs, not just handing over requirements.
* Own a centralized use\-case intake and evaluation process — assessing new agent proposals for business value, technical feasibility, and risk before they enter the roadmap.
* Define and track success metrics for each agent and for the capability overall (adoption, quality/accuracy, cycle\-time and effort savings, cost\-to\-serve) and report capability health to leadership.
* Represent the end user and the business in every prioritization decision — pushing back when a technically impressive capability does not make the user’s experience genuinely better.

jobs.description:
**Why** **LSP44****?**



LSP44 is the AI\-native agent and API infrastructure company for logistics service providers \- the 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers who move the world’s freight. Built on more than a decade of the largest logistics data graph and carrier network on Earth (280,000\+ carriers, 1\.5 billion shipments, 706 million carrier events processed daily), LSP44 gives LSPs the AI agents, carrier infrastructure, and developer capabilities to embed intelligence directly into their own products and workflows.



LSP44 isn’t a startup chasing a market \- it’s the original infrastructure project44 built starting in 2014, and nine of the world’s ten largest logistics service providers already run on it. LSP44 launched profitable on day one, with its own sales, engineering, and product leadership, and a mandate to move at the speed of the LSPs it serves.



If you want to build technology that ships in days instead of quarters, that LSPs embed directly into how they operate, and that’s grounded in more data and context than anyone else in the category \- we should talk.


**AI at LSP44**



Every LSP44 team member is expected to be an intelligent, hands\-on user of AI \- and for Product, that bar is even higher: the products you’re defining are AI agents. We don’t expect everyone to be a data scientist, but we do expect everyone to identify where AI adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate its outputs critically, and govern it responsibly, in your own workflow and in the products you build.


**Overview**



We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build LSP44’s next generation of AI agent and API infrastructure, in close partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. This is a hands\-on, builder role on a small, senior product team: you’ll own product areas across the LSP44 agent portfolio \- spanning carrier procurement, rate \& quote, dispatch, exception recovery, visibility, documents, and freight audit \- working directly with forward\-deployed engineers and customers to turn deep operational knowledge of how 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers work into shipped product.


**What** **you’ll** **own**



You’ll define the strategy and roadmap for one or more areas of the LSP44 agent portfolio and technology, grounded in direct conversations with LSP customers and the realities of how logistics service providers operate, embed, and buy. * Partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers embedded with LSP customers to surface real needs and validate solutions in production
* Write clear specs and PRDs, and drive execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, from definition through ship
* Ensure everything you build is designed to embed cleanly into a customer’s own tech stack via API and SDK \- LSP44 products are built to be embedded, not adopted
* Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure new agent capabilities are field\-ready at launch


**Ideal background**


* Product management experience in logistics, supply chain, freight brokerage, TMS, or another operationally complex B2B/API\-first domain
* Comfortable operating in a lean, fast\-moving, 0\-to\-1 environment, partnering tightly with engineering rather than through hand\-offs
* Strong customer instinct \- able to run discovery independently and translate operator\-level detail into product direction
* Experience with API or developer\-facing products a plus


**Requirements \& Skills**


* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline that has built your technical or analytical chops, from computer science to business
* 4\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, logistics, or infrastructure/API products
* Track record of partnering directly with engineering to define and ship technical products
* Strong written and verbal communication, able to translate between technical and business stakeholders
* Comfortable working across distributed teams and time zones
* Supply chain, logistics, or freight brokerage experience is a strong plus
* Detail\-oriented but strategic — equally comfortable in the weeds of implementation and presenting direction to leadership


**Diversity \& Inclusion**



At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. **About us:**  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is  

important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.  

  

**Team overview:**  

Right along with Target’s distinctive retail brand, we are constantly improving and innovating our digital shopping experience. Are you ready to excel in the fast\-changing retail environment? Are you a customer service enthusiast who’s curious about the guest and can see the shopping journey through their eyes? Then you’ll have success on the Digital Strategy \& Platform team, whose goal is to offer guests a seamless online shopping experience across our platforms—including Target.com and the store network’s fulfillment capabilities. Here, you’ll collaborate to create and implement the digital strategies that enrich the online experience through the right mix of personalization, simplicity and intuitiveness. Your ideas will support Target in complementing the beloved in\-store shopping interaction with a convenient, reliable and instantly gratifying digital experience.

**Role overview:**


As a Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will collaborate with your product team and key stakeholders to develop a plan and business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to build a strong knowledge of your product through product discovery to collect customer feedback and work to collect other relevant data points that explain the value and help you prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.


You will be the “voice of the product” with your product team and stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and you will be responsible to maintain and refine the product backlog (create user stories \& acceptance criteria) while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.


You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles.


Core responsibilities of this job are to **Support Marketplace Portal (Seller Central)** in connecting with enterprise systems, delivering end to end experience for third party sellers to run their business on Target.com. You will be responsible for addressing Partner pain points across our APIs, and various points of connection and interaction. You will implement compliance, scalability and other key initiatives that help us drive our business as one of the top growth levers for Target.

**About you:**

* Four\-year degree or equivalent experience
* 4\+ years of **Product management** experience or equivalent domain experience
* Technical aptitude and Customer Empathy
* Experience working in an agile environment
* Proficient in writing use cases, BRDs and data driven prioritization
* Strong communication skills


Preferred Qualifications

* Prior eCommerce/retail industry experience
* Prior experience building discovery\-based software applications
* Familiarity with APIs, middleware, and system integration
* Strong analytical skills to solve complex workflow and system challenges
* Experience in building 0\-1 products, A/B Testing and finding product market fit
* Ability to work with both technical and non\-technical teams to drive alignment
* MBA preferred


Why Join Us

* Be at the forefront of building a scalable marketplace ecosystem
* Work on high\-impact initiatives connecting enterprise systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance partner experiences

Job Title
   

  

 Product Manager IGT\-S
   

  

**Job Description**
**Prod** 
**uct Manager IGT\-S**
 As Product Manager, you will support product planning, development, and lifecycle management activities while applying strong AI expertise to enhance customer insight generation, requirements development, data\-driven decision\-making, and product management practices. You will work in a global, multidisciplinary environment within Philips Healthcare, helping to deliver innovative solutions that create value for customers and patients.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As Product Manager, you will work closely with cross\-functional teams to translate customer, market, and business needs into product requirements and roadmap recommendations. A strong background in Artificial Intelligence is essential, as you will be expected to leverage AI technologies and AI\-driven approaches to improve product management effectiveness, uncover actionable insights, streamline decision\-making, and drive innovation across all phases of product development and lifecycle management.
   

  

* Support product roadmap development, business case creation, and PDLM planning activities using customer, market, and data\-driven insights, including AI\-enabled analysis tools.
* Contribute to product development and PDLM activities from concept through launch, sustaining engineering, and lifecycle management while leveraging AI\-enabled approaches to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Gather, analyze, and synthesize customer, clinical, market, and field insights into actionable product requirements using modern analytics and AI\-assisted tools.
* Work closely with R\&D, Architecture, Clinical, Service, RA, Quality, and commercial teams to deliver successful products and support PDLM execution.
* Support product lifecycle activities, including feature enhancements, compatibility management, obsolescence planning, and customer\-driven improvements.
* Monitor product adoption, customer satisfaction, product quality, and business performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive data\-informed decision\-making using modern analytics, AI\-powered insights, and digital tools.
* Leverage AI technologies and productivity tools to improve product discovery, customer insight generation, requirements definition, evidence generation, and overall product management effectiveness.
* Evaluate emerging technology trends, including AI, to identify opportunities to enhance products, workflows, and customer value.
* Influence stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to support product objectives and business priorities.


**You are a part of** 
 Image Guided Therapy Systems (IGT\-S) is a global leader in image\-guided solutions that enable minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment across multiple clinical domains. The IGT\-S organization is responsible for the global marketing, development, and manufacturing of innovative systems, software, and services that help clinicians perform complex procedures with greater precision, efficiency, and confidence.
   

  

 You will be part of the Product Management team, working closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to translate customer, clinical, and business needs into successful products and solutions. The team is responsible for driving product innovation, supporting new product development, and managing products throughout their lifecycle.
   

  

 As part of Philips Healthcare, you will contribute to meaningful innovations that improve patient outcomes and enhance the experience of both clinicians and patients. This position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Director of Product Management.
   

  

**You Are Fit If**
* Master's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of experience in Product Management, Marketing, Strategy, or related leadership roles in a technology\-driven environment.
* Experience in healthcare technology, medical devices, or regulated industries is preferred.
* Strong background in Artificial Intelligence, including practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI\-assisted product development, and AI\-driven business processes.
* Demonstrated ability to apply AI technologies to solve customer problems, drive business outcomes, and improve product management effectiveness.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience applying AI to improve productivity, innovation, or business processes.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot and other AI\-enabled productivity tools.
* Experience working within Product Development Lifecycle Management (PDLM) processes
* Experience supporting global product launches and post\-market product lifecycle activities.
* Knowledge of medical device regulations and quality processes.

 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office\-based teams, this means working in\-person at least 3 days per week.
   

  

 Onsite roles require full\-time presence in the company’s facilities.
   

  

 Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.

 We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Delhivery One** 




 Delhivery One is the operating system for India’s SMB and D2C shippers — the single platform through which more than 45,000 SMB and D2C shippers manage their end\-to\-end logistics every month, for both domestic and international shipping. From creating B2C and B2B orders and managing pickups, to tracking NDRs and RTOs, settling COD remittances, disputing weight mismatches, filing lost and damaged claims, and activating value\-added services — Delhivery One handles the full shipper lifecycle across domestic, cross\-border, and intracity shipping.
 



 Beyond core shipping, we’ve been doing some exciting work building AI\-native value\-added services directly on top of Delhivery’s network — things that only work because they’re inside the network, not bolted on from outside. There’s a lot more to build here, and we’d love to have you be part of it.
 



 We are building the best B2B product experience in India for SMB and D2C shippers, and we are doing it AI\-first.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will own a significant product surface on Delhivery One — spanning core shipper workflows (order management, NDR, finances, claims) and the AI\-native value\-added services that sit on top of them. Your job is to make both layers exceptional: workflows that are fast, clear, and nearly effortless for an SMB shipper; and AI services that work reliably at scale and get better over time.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role. You will define what you build, why, and to what standard — and you will be accountable for the outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 




**Own the shipper experience end\-to\-end** 




 Define what great looks like for your product area across the full SMB shipper journey — first ship, daily operations, exception handling, billing, claims resolution. Work closely with Design and Engineering to raise the craft bar on every flow. Notice when a workflow has one step too many. Push for better.
 



**Build and ship AI\-native features** 




 Design features where AI is the primary mechanism — not a layer bolted on after. Ship them to production, instrument them, and iterate based on real data. Understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and how to evaluate model quality as a PM.
 



**Set outcome metrics and own them** 




 Define success before you build — activation rate, AI resolution rate, shipper effort score, claim resolution TAT. Treat these as seriously as the features themselves.
 



**Lead cross\-functional execution** 




 Drive alignment across Design, Engineering, Finance, Ops, and Business. Write specs that engineers can act on and that leadership can evaluate. Move fast without losing precision.
 



  





**Is This You?** 




**You have an ownership bias.** 




 When something is broken, you fix it — you don’t wait for someone to assign it to you. You treat the product as if it’s yours, because it is. You follow up, you close loops, and you hold the bar even when no one is watching.
 



**You have an urgency bias.** 




 You move faster than the average PM. You know the difference between “needs more thought” and “we’re overthinking this.” You bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating over waiting for perfect information.
 



**You can go deep without losing the picture.** 




 You can sit in a claims escalation review and understand the edge cases — and then step back and articulate the strategic bet. You don’t get lost in details, and you don’t hide behind strategy to avoid them. You do both.
 



**You have shipped AI\-native product work.** 




 Not prototypes. Not internal tools. Features in production where AI is the primary mechanism — and you can talk about what worked, what didn’t, and how you measured it. You understand confidence thresholds, fallback design, and human\-in\-the\-loop tradeoffs.
 



**You have craft for user experience.** 




 You have an aesthetic. You give sharp design feedback and you act on it. You notice when an error message blames the user, when an empty state is a missed opportunity, or when a flow has one step too many — and you do something about it.
 



**You write well.** 




 Your specs don’t require a meeting to understand. You can write a one\-pager for a founder and a detailed flow for an engineer, and both leave with clarity.
 



**If this is you, you will thrive here.** 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 4–7 years in Product Management. You have shipped at least one product that real users rely on daily, and you can tell a clear story about the decisions that made it work.
 



 Domain comfort with B2B or logistics complexity is a plus, but not required. What is required is the ability to get up to speed fast — by talking to SMB shippers, digging into ops workflows, and building mental models quickly.

**Why 
 

 LSP44
 

 ?**

  
 





 LSP44 is the AI\-native agent and API infrastructure company for logistics service providers \- the 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers who move the world’s freight. Built on more than a decade of the largest logistics data graph and carrier network on Earth (280,000\+ carriers, 1\.5 billion shipments, 706 million carrier events processed daily), LSP44 gives LSPs the AI agents, carrier infrastructure, and developer capabilities to embed intelligence directly into their own products and workflows.
 

  
 





 LSP44 isn’t a startup chasing a market \- it’s the original infrastructure project44 built starting in 2014, and nine of the world’s ten largest logistics service providers already run on it. LSP44 launched profitable on day one, with its own sales, engineering, and product leadership, and a mandate to move at the speed of the LSPs it serves.
 

  
 





 If you want to build technology that ships in days instead of quarters, that LSPs embed directly into how they operate, and that’s grounded in more data and context than anyone else in the category \- we should talk.
 

  
 




**AI at LSP44**

  
 





 Every LSP44 team member is expected to be an intelligent, hands\-on user of AI \- and for Product, that bar is even higher: the products you’re defining are AI agents. We don’t expect everyone to be a data scientist, but we do expect everyone to identify where AI adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate its outputs critically, and govern it responsibly, in your own workflow and in the products you build.
 

  
 




**Overview**

  
 





 We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build LSP44’s next generation of AI agent and API infrastructure, in close partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing. This is a hands\-on, builder role on a small, senior product team: you’ll own product areas across the LSP44 agent portfolio \- spanning carrier procurement, rate \& quote, dispatch, exception recovery, visibility, documents, and freight audit \- working directly with forward\-deployed engineers and customers to turn deep operational knowledge of how 3PLs, freight forwarders, and brokers work into shipped product.
 

  
 




**What 
 

 you’ll
 

  own**

  
 





 You’ll define the strategy and roadmap for one or more areas of the LSP44 agent portfolio and technology, grounded in direct conversations with LSP customers and the realities of how logistics service providers operate, embed, and buy. You’ll partner daily with Engineering \- including forward\-deployed engineers working on\-site with customers \- to translate operational context into requirements, and you’ll carry those requirements through delivery: scoping, prioritizing, and keeping trade\-offs visible along the way.
 

  
 




**Key responsibilities**

  
 



* Define and own product strategy and roadmap for one or more LSP44 agent product lines and technology, in partnership with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.
* Translate deep knowledge of LSP operations \- carrier procurement, dispatch, exception management, freight audit, and more \- into clear, prioritized product requirements
* Partner closely with forward\-deployed engineers embedded with LSP customers to surface real needs and validate solutions in production
* Write clear specs and PRDs, and drive execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, from definition through ship
* Ensure everything you build is designed to embed cleanly into a customer’s own tech stack via API and SDK \- LSP44 products are built to be embedded, not adopted
* Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure new agent capabilities are field\-ready at launch



**Ideal background**

  
 



* Product management experience in logistics, supply chain, freight brokerage, TMS, or another operationally complex B2B/API\-first domain
* Comfortable operating in a lean, fast\-moving, 0\-to\-1 environment, partnering tightly with engineering rather than through hand\-offs
* Strong customer instinct \- able to run discovery independently and translate operator\-level detail into product direction
* Experience with API or developer\-facing products a plus



**Requirements \& Skills**

  
 



* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline that has built your technical or analytical chops, from computer science to business
* 4\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, logistics, or infrastructure/API products
* Track record of partnering directly with engineering to define and ship technical products
* Strong written and verbal communication, able to translate between technical and business stakeholders
* Comfortable working across distributed teams and time zones
* Supply chain, logistics, or freight brokerage experience is a strong plus
* Detail\-oriented but strategic — equally comfortable in the weeds of implementation and presenting direction to leadership



**Diversity \& Inclusion** 
  
 



 At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world\-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day. 
 



 We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. You will act as the owner for platform strategy, ensuring that ServiceNow delivers measurable business value, supports standardized ITSM processes, and enables future\-ready capabilities such as CSDM adoption and AI\-driven automation.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Citi is looking for an energetic, motivated professional to join its Fraud Analytics team as a Business Analyst.


As part of the Global Fraud Analytics team, this role manages and executes the fraud analytics and strategies supporting Citi’s North American Retail Bank business. This includes leveraging data to identify fraud trends, designing and implementing strategies to prevent and mitigate fraud attacks across the fraud lifecycle, including application and synthetic ID fraud, account takeover and sophisticated new attack schemes.


This role partners closely with Senior stakeholders, Fraud Policy, Fraud Operations, and technology teams in order to determine potential and existing fraud impacts and implement the strategic interventions.


**Primary responsibilities include:**


* Leverage analytics to identify enhancement opportunities and more granular insights that can be acted upon, while ensuring adherence to Fraud Policy.
* Ownership and management of fraud rules, scores, and detection strategies
* Analysis of customer data and transactional data to identify emerging fraud trends, develop, and improve fraud strategies.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to provide strategy recommendations based on data and trend analysis and implement mitigation strategies.
* Generate and manage regular and ad\-hoc reporting to enable effective monitoring and identification of emerging trends.
* Continually assess manual and automated processes to identify potential process gaps and opportunities.
* Analysis of customer data and transactional data to identify emerging fraud trends, develop, and improve fraud strategies.
* Periodic review and development of MIS reports, dashboards, and communication of fraud results internally and to the business using advanced visualization techniques.

**Required Qualifications / Skills:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
* Engineering / MBA background from a premier institute
* Minimum 2\+ years of hands\-on analytical experience
* Hands on experience in : SAS / SQL, Python (mandatory)
* Ability to work in a fast paced, dynamic, environment.
* Hands on experience in data visualization tools, such as Tableau
* Analytical and problem\-solving ability to deliver projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; experience with stakeholder management

jobs.title: Business Systems and Change Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
   

  

 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
   

  

 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
   

  

 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position** 
 :
   

  

 The Business Systems and Change Analyst is responsible for processing change orders and successfully implementing system and processes improvements in the Document Control department. The position represents Document Control department in projects and collaborates with cross\-functional departments, ensuring Compliance with Intuitive Document Control Standards and Regulatory requirements. Work closely with the senior Business and Systems Process Analysts to draft and review requirements, test scripts and execute PLM system and process updates. This position reports directly to the Senior Manager, Document Control.
   

  

**Essential Job Duties**
* Execute improvement activities for the PLM system (Agile) and Document Control Processes
* Represent Document Control during requirements definition phase of projects
* Participate in planning sessions for approved projects to provide input to requirements
* Participate in multiple project teams. Work with business owners to ensure the team understands users’ business activities and that the acceptance criteria are defined.
* Participate in daily stand\-ups, resolve conflict, and escalate as required
* Create test scripts related to PLM and Document Control projects. Execute User Acceptance testing.
* Work with Computer System Validation (CSV) groups in Regulatory and IT to ensure project compliance with regulatory and Intuitive CSV policies and procedures
* Identify and resolve project issues and manage project dependencies within the Document Control environment to keep the critical path on track.
* Update impacted procedures and ensure all required documentation is updated and released at the time of project implementation
* Support and Contribute to the Agile Training Forum. Provide input to slide content related to processes and PLM system questions.
* Review, assess and implement approval matrix requests. Provide support in approval matrix improvements.
* Review and assess Document Control tickets to understand issue details and requirements. Resolve the complex Document Control tickets.
* Become embedded in the process – spend a portion of time processing ECOs and responding to internal customer issues
* Support the Senior System and Business Analyst on assigned tasks and projects
* Process a daily quota of change orders to support the business
* Process complex change orders accurately and timely using the electronic documentation system, based on professional concepts and company objectives.
* Audit documentation changes for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with language, procedural, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure changes are in a closed loop with all discrepancies addressed before release, where analysis of situations or data requires knowledge of regulatory and change control principles.
* Provide clear verbal and written communication to internal customers, including guidance to originators on correcting issues or discrepancies.
* Promptly respond to questions and issues raised by Originators and Approvers
* Raise issues applicable to the Document Control team and offer detailed solutions and alternatives with justification for actions.
* Maintain data integrity within Agile form fields and update item forms within Agile to accommodate changes within company processes and requirements
* Have in\-depth Agile system and change control processes knowledge in order to troubleshoot issues as needed and know when to escalate them to IT
* Understand how Agile links to other systems within and outside Intuitive. Provide support on Agile integration\-related requests.
* Update Document and Change Control procedures as needed


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Experience in a Regulatory/Quality organization in a medical device company
* Experience with and knowledge of both the functional and technical aspects of a PLM system, Agile preferred
* knowledge of Change Control principles for Document Control and IT systems
* Experience working on process and system improvement projects
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Visio)
* Strong critical and analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills
* Strong attention to detail.
* Planning and organizing adaptability; ability to react to project adjustments \& alterations promptly and efficiently
* Experience working with 5\+ person cross\-functional project teams
* Ability to be both “hands on” and to work in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment
* Ability to work in a high stress, ever changing environment
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively to both business stakeholders and technical team members (e.g. IT)
* Self\-starter, able to work with minimal supervision


**Qualifications**
**Required Education and Training**
* University degree with a minimum of 6\-10 years of equivalent work experience.
* Quality System Regulations and ISO requirements…
